title: ROZE PE MUSTAFA KE UDASEE SI CHAAYI HAI
body:
ROZE PE MUSTAFA KE UDASEE SI CHAAYI HAI
NANA AJEEB SAANAAE HAM PAR GUZAR GAYE, RANJ O ALAM NE GHER LIYAA HUM JIDHAR GAYE
NANA KHUDAA KAI GHAR MEIN NA HUM KO AMAAN MILI, BHAI NE SHEHER CHOD KE JANGAL KI RAAH LI
NANA HAMAIN NA CHAIN MAYASSAR KAHIN HUA, PAANI BHI BANDH HUM PAI LAEENON NE KARDIYA
<<DIVIDER>>
NANA TUMHARI AAL PAI KYA KYA SITAM HUE, BACHCHE TADAP KEI MAR GAYE PAANI KAI WAASTE
NANA SHAHEED HO GAYE BHAI KAI JAANNISAR, EK EK KAR KE MAR GAYE ASHAB E ZEEWAQAR
NANA BALA KE BAN MAIN QAYAMAT KA RUN PADA, BHAYEE SAI BHAYEE BAAP SAI BETA BICHAD GAYA
NANA ZAMEEN E KARBOBALAA LAAL HO GAYI, QASIM KI LAASH GHODON SE PAAMAAL HO GAYI
<<DIVIDER>>
NANA KATAA KE SHAANON KO ABBAS MARGAYE, GHURBAT ME BHAAIJAAN KO BE AAS KARGAYE
NANA TUMHARI SHAKL KA FARZAND EK JO THA, KHAA KAR SINA JIGAR ME WO MEHRU BHI CHAL BASA
NANA SHAQI KI TEER SE ASGAR HUA SHAHEED, AISA HUA NA HOGA JAHAAN MAIN SITAM SHADEED
NANA HUSSAIN BEKAS O BE YAAR HOGAYE, AAMADA QATL KARNE KO KUFFAR HOGAYE
<<DIVIDER>>
TADPE JO ZER KHANJARE BE AAB SHAAHE DEEN, SHIMRE LAEEN KE ZULM SE THARRA GAYI ZAMEEN
NANA HAMARE GHAR KA SAB ASBAAB LUT GAYA, NANA HAMARE SAR PE NA BAAQI RAHI RIDA
NANA HAZAAR TARHA JAFA KI LAEENO NE, KHAIMO ME AAG LAGAADI LAEENO NE
NANA HUI ASEER TUMHAARI NAWASIYAAN, KAUNO MAKAAN ME CHAA GAYI GHAM KI UDAASIYAAN
<<DIVIDER>>
NANA HARAM HUSSAIN KE BAZAAR ME GAYE, HUM SAR BAREHNA KUFE KE DARBAR ME GAYE
NANA TUMHAARI AAL GAYI MULKE SHAAM ME, POHNCHI ALI KI BETIYAAN DARBAARE AAM ME
NANA HAQEER SAAHIB E TATHEER HOGAYE,HAM LOG SHAHR E SHAAM MAIN TASHHEER HOGAYE
NANA ASEER BARA THE HUM EK THI RASAN, BAANDHE GAYE THAI MISLE GUNAAHGAAR E KHASTATAN
<<DIVIDER>>
NANA HUM APNE HAAL PE ROTE THE ZAAR ZAAR, NANA HAMAARE ROONE PE HASTE THE BAD SHAIAAR
NANA AJEEB HAAL HAMAARAA THA US GHADI, EK BIBI PICHHE DUSRI BIBI KE CHUPTI THI
US WAQT THARTHARI SI MERE TAN ME PAD GAYI, SAD HAIF HAI ZAMMEN MAIN ZAINAB NA GHAD GAYI
ITNE ME EK SHAAMI NAI NANA GHAZAB KIYA, SAIDANI KU KANEEZI MAIN APNI TALAB KIYA
<<DIVIDER>>
HOTI THI LAAKH ZILLATEN HUM DEKHTE RAHE, HANS HANS KE TAAZIYAANE SITAM JHELTE RAHE
NANAA TABAAH HOKE HAM AAYE HAIN SHAAM SE, EK DAAGHE NAU SAKINA KA LAAYE HAI SHAAM SE
NANA HAMARE TAN PE NISHAANO KO DEKH LO, AB TAK HAI NEEL RASSI KE SHAANON KO DEKH LO
ZAINAB DIKHA KAI SHANOON KU JAB KARRAHI THI BAYAAN, THARAA RAHAA THA ROUZAE SULTAANE MASHRAQAIN
<<DIVIDER>>
BAS KHATM KAR NASHAR YE GHAMNAAK DAASTAAN, ROTE HAIN IS ALAM MAIN ZAMEEN AUR AASMAAN
